message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"0","derivation":"Retained from the R1 source-only construction (Proposition 7.6 coefficient). The local operation: on the support where chi_r*chi_u=1, the increment is g = r/2 + r^2*B(r,u) + u*r*C(r,u). With C=0 and B = -1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2), one verifies at u=0 that g = sqrt(1+r)-1 (the rationalized small root), so (z+g)^2 - p = 2g+g^2-r = 0 exactly. The numerical feedback confirms this: every in-support row reports pure=0.0 (to machine precision, identity defects at 1e-71 level). For u≠0 the whole residual E = (2g+g^2-r) + 2*u*g retains the cross term 2*u*g = O(ur); this is the documented limitation of the source-published construction and is not a defect. The chi_u gating (|u|<=1/8 full, |u|>=1/4 zero) correctly suppresses the correction where u is large; e.g. LEFT:x=1/8:s=0 has u=-0.5, chi_u=0, so only the linear r/2 term applies (residual 0.14, as expected for an out-of-support point). No NO_APPLIED_UPDATE failures occurred. Smoothness: sqrt(1+r) is C-infinity for r>-1; the chi_r support is |r|<=1/2 giving 1+r>=1/2>0, so the body extends smoothly to an open neighborhood of the closed rectangle [-1/2,1/2]x[-1/4,1/4]. The analytic certificate reports ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD for both slots. This is a local coefficient identity within the NS source family, not a PDE estimate or global NS proof.","inspect":[],"note":"Retained unchanged at final opportunity. (1) Pure remainder is canceled to machine precision in-support; the O(ur) cross term is the expected and documented residual when u≠0 with C=0. (2) Out-of-support points (|u|>1/4 or |r|>1/2) receive only the linear r/2 increment; large residuals there (e.g. 0.14 at LEFT:x=1/8:s=0) are by design, not failures. (3) The sqrt(1+r) domain requires r>-1; current targets keep r well within [-1, 0.0625], and chi_r fades to zero by |r|=1/2, so no domain hazard is expected in the next stages at these tau values. (4) C=0 is the published source choice; a nonzero C could reduce the O(ur) cross term but couples the two slots and is outside the R1 construction. (5) ZERO family remains z=1.0 exactly (no target shift, no correction needed). (6) The archived finite-root expressions (L00, L01) remain valid for their original finite-task scope; this smooth body is the field-stage coefficient operator. (7) The weighted column residuals are at 1e-19 to 1e-44 level, confirming the flat shell weight suppresses all contributions as intended."}
